basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Seattle, majoring in English Literature. I recently got into Reddit to explore my interests in video games, particularly narrative-driven ones like Life is Strange. My favorite pastime is reading and writing fanfiction, and I'm always on the lookout for new stories or fancomics to delve into. In my free time, I also enjoy cycling around the city on my Brompton bike. I'm single and usually online during the evenings after classes and on weekends when I have more time to engage with the community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in storytelling, which I cultivate through my studies in English Literature. My love for video games, especially narrative-heavy ones like Life is Strange, has led me to explore fanfiction as a form of self-expression and community engagement.
